item.title: POSCO International and Glenfarne finalise Alaska LNG partnership
item.description: Glenfarne Alaska LNG, LLC and POSCO International Corp. have signed definitive agreements finalising the formation of a strategic partnership for the development of the Alaska LNG project.

item.title: Conrad Shipyard and Samsung Heavy Industries announce MoU to advance US bunkering
item.description: Conrad Shipyard, LLC and Samsung Heavy Industries Co., Ltd have announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding that formalises a collaborative framework to jointly explore opportunities in the rapidly expanding US LNG bunkering market.

item.title: EU Methane Regulation emerges as strategic tool for energy security
item.description: The Environmental Defense Fund Europe has released a new analysis by Rystad Energy, showing that the EU Methane Regulation is a strategic tool to strengthen Europe's energy security and accelerate its shift away from Russian fossil fuels.

item.title: HAM Group’s service stations to sell bio-LNG/bio-CNG
item.description: During 2026, all of HAM Group’s service stations will exclusively sell bio-LNG and/or bio-NG, starting with Monegros, Baix Ebre, and Gironès Nord.

item.title: EnerMech awarded pre-commissioning scope from Bechtel for Woodside’s Pluto LNG 2 facility
item.description: EnerMech has secured a contract from Bechtel Corp. to deliver chemical cleaning services for Woodside Energy’s Pluto Train 2 LNG development in Western Australia.

item.title: ADNOC L&S takes delivery of fourth new-build LNG carrier
item.description: ADNOC Logistics & Services plc has taken delivery of Al Sadaf, the fourth of six new-build LNG carriers from the Jiangnan Shipyard in China.

item.title: Snam to purchase interest in OLT Offshore LNG Toscana
item.description: Snam has agreed to acquire Igneo Infrastructure Partners’ 48.2% interest in OLT Offshore LNG Toscana S.p.A.

item.title: McDermott awarded EPCIC contract by PETRONAS
item.description: McDermott has secured a subsea contract from PETRONAS Carigali Brunei Ltd for EPCIC of a natural gas development project offshore Brunei Darussalam.

item.title: Galveston LNG Bunker Port signs agreement for LNG bunker fuel
item.description: Galveston LNG Bunker Port has executed a heads of agreement with an international shipping company for the supply of LNG bunker fuel.

item.title: Edison signs contract with Knutsen
item.description: Edison has signed a contract with shipowner Knutsen OAS Shipping for the long-term charter of an LNG carrier.
